_README: Map each video basename to its externally hosted URL and poster. Fill in 'src' with the CDN URL (e.g. https://res.cloudinary.com/.../01.mp4) and 'poster' with a still image (local path like images/video-posters/visuals-01.jpg, or a hosted URL). Entries with an empty 'src' are ignored and fall back to the local file. Keys may include or omit the .mp4 extension. After editing, run: npm run media (or npm run build).
